name: tilt-furniture-simple
description: Simple ladder for multi-axis furniture tilt (tiltFurniture, SweetHome3DJS parity). Verifies the flag is OFF in Simple / ON in Pro, then places a floor lamp, tilts it via tiltItem (pitch+roll), and confirms the item carries the tilt + renders without crashing. Screenshots an upright vs tilted side-by-side.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-flag-off-in-simple
steps.failMessage: tiltFurniture should be OFF in Simple mode (pro-tier)

steps.name: verify-flag-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: tiltFurniture should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: verify-item-tilted

waitFor.store: (() => { const it = state.items.find(i => i.id==='tilt-lamp'); return it && Math.abs(it.pitch - 0.5) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(it.roll + 0.35) < 1e-6; })()

steps.failMessage: tiltItem did not store pitch/roll on the item

steps.name: verify-reset

waitFor.store: (() => { const it = state.items.find(i => i.id==='tilt-lamp'); return it && it.pitch === undefined && it.roll === undefined; })()

steps.failMessage: reset did not clear pitch/roll back to undefined
